literal.prompt: В какой стране расположен национальный парк Крюгера?

literalGroups.primaryGround: SANParks identifies Kruger National Park in its official cross-border conservation passage that names South Africa, Mozambique and Zimbabwe. The alternatives are each a named national park/reserve in the other countries: UNESCO/Narok/MEFT contexts locate Serengeti in Tanzania, Maasai Mara in Kenya and Etosha in Namibia. The clue asks broad country location and does not depend on a border-crossing anecdote.
